facility.name: A+ Appletree Academy
facility.programs_provided: Meals Provided ,After School Care,Skill Classes,Part Time Care,Transportation to/from School ,Field Trips

provenance.note: Census Geocoder Exact match: 619 E 9TH ST, MISSION, TX, 78572

inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records -Training Hours: Health / Safety related training certificates for four out of six staff files reviewed were not available at the time of inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records -Training Hours (26 TAC §746.901(6))

occurrences.finding: AP Initial background checks submitted - At the time you hire someone: A caregiver was present at operation and providing care for children without prior background check eligibility notice.     Note: This was corrected at inspection when caregiver left building.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Initial background checks submitted - At the time you hire someone (26 TAC §745.621(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Child-Care Center Must be Equipped with a Working Carbon Monoxide (CO) Detection System: The carbon monoxide detector installed at the operation is not working.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child-Care Center Must be Equipped with a Working Carbon Monoxide (CO) Detection System (26 TAC §746.5531)

occurrences.finding: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Safety Documentation for Emergency Drills, Fire Extinguishers, & Smoke Detectors: Emergency practices documentation for this year (2026) was not available for review at the time of inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Safety Documentation for Emergency Drills, Fire Extinguishers, & Smoke Detectors (26 TAC §746.801(10))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records -Training Hours: Health / Safety related training certificates for four out of six staff files reviewed were not available at the time of inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records -Training Hours (26 TAC §746.901(6))

occurrences.finding: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children: One caregiver was providing care for 5 chilidren ges 3mo, 6mo, 10mo, 11mo and 14mo. Classroom was over ratio by one child.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1601)

occurrences.finding: Child Passenger Safety Seat System - Not expired or damaged in accident: There are two expired car seats in the transportation vehicle; one expired 2024 and the second on 02/2026.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child Passenger Safety Seat System - Not expired or damaged in accident (26 TAC §746.5607(b))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information-Child's allergies and Completed Food Allergy Plan: Emergency plan for a child with a food allergy was not available for review at the time of inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information-Child's allergies and Completed Food Allergy Plan (26 TAC §746.605(15))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards: One of the playground canopies is broken.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards (26 TAC §746.3701)

occurrences.finding: Documented Annual Training- Required Content: Four out of six staff files reviewed are missing trainings on the following topics:    -Hazardous Materials;   -Administering Medications;   -Emergency Preparedness; and   -Building and Physical Premises Safety.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documented Annual Training- Required Content (26 TAC §746.1309(e))

occurrences.finding: AP Report Child Injury Requiring Medical Treatment by a Health-Care Professional or Hospitalization: Based on the information obtained during the DFPS investigation, it was determined that operation failed to timely report to CCR an incident that took place at operation which required a child to receive medical treatment.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Report Child Injury Requiring Medical Treatment by a Health-Care Professional or Hospitalization (26 TAC §746.305(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Personnel and Training Records: The personnel records for two caregivers were not available for review at the operation during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Personnel and Training Records (26 TAC §746.801(3))

occurrences.finding: Infant May Not Sleep in a Restrictive Device - Remove the infant from the device and place the infant in a crib as soon as possible: Two infants in the infant room were observed asleep on swings for an undetermined amount of time.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Infant May Not Sleep in a Restrictive Device - Remove the infant from the device and place the infant in a crib as soon as possible (26 TAC §746.2426(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Adequate Lighting During Naptime: The lighting in the infant room during naptime was not adequate and did not allow visual supervision of all children in the room.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Adequate Lighting During Naptime (26 TAC §746.2911)

occurrences.finding: Director Annual Training - Additional required topics: The director was missing annual training for training year 3/22/2023-3/21/2024 on the following topics:      1. Understanding building and physical premises safety, including identification and protection from hazards that can cause bodily injury such as electrical hazards, bodies of water, and vehicular traffic; and    2.Handling, storing, and disposing of hazardous materials including compliance with 746.3425 of this chapter (relating to Must caregivers wear gloves when handling blood or bodily fluids containing blood?).
occurrences.violation_type_title: Director Annual Training - Additional required topics (26 TAC §746.1311(e))

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Promotion of Physical Activity: The operational policies reviewed were missing information on the promotion of indoor and outdoor physical activity that is consistent with Subchapter F of the minimum standards (relating to Developmental Activities and Activity Plan); the policies must include:     (A) The benefits of physical activity and outdoor play;     (B) The duration of physical activity at the operation, both indoor and outdoor;     (C) The type of physical activity (structured and unstructured) that children may engage in at the operation;     (D) Each setting in which the physical activity program will take place;     (E) The recommended clothing and footwear that will allow a child to participate freely and safely in physical activities;     (F) The criteria the operation will use to determine when extreme weather conditions pose a significant health risk that prohibits or limits outdoor play; and     (G) A plan to ensure physical activity occurs on days when extreme weather conditions prohibit or limit outdoor play.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Promotion of Physical Activity (26 TAC §746.501(a)(18))

occurrences.finding: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days: The feeding instructions available for review were not current for three infants who are not yet ready for table food. Two of the feeding instruction forms had a date of 8/28/2023, and a third form had a date of 9/26/2023.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days (26 TAC §746.2421(b))

occurrences.finding: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children: Child/caregiver ratios were not met in the infant room when a caregiver was caring for five infants. The ages of the children in the group were a 4 month old, 7 month old, 9 month old, 14 month old, and 19 month old. According to the ratio chart the maximum number of children one caregiver may supervise is 4. The group was out of ratio by one child.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1601)

occurrences.finding: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment: The grass in the outdoor playground was not maintained.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)

occurrences.finding: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Personnel and Training Records: A caregiver's record was not available for review at the operation during the inspection. A second caregiver's training record was not available for review during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Personnel and Training Records (26 TAC §746.801(3))

occurrences.finding: Electronic Child Safety Alarm - installed and maintained according to manufacturer's instructions: The electronic child safety alarm in the transportation vehicle was not maintained. When testing the electronic child safety alarm there was no sound indicating the alarm was working properly.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Electronic Child Safety Alarm - installed and maintained according to manufacturer's instructions (26 TAC §746.5625(b))

occurrences.finding: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Employees' Attendance: There were no time sheets available for one of the directors.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Employees' Attendance (26 TAC §746.801(5))

occurrences.finding: Transportation Safety Training -Director and Employee Complete 2 Hours Annually: One of two directors was not current on transportation safety training.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Transportation Safety Training -Director and Employee Complete 2 Hours Annually (26 TAC §746.1316(a))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Immunizations: 1 of 4 children's immunization records reviewed was not current.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Immunizations (26 TAC §746.603(a)(4))
